1.why: All screenshots show a clean, static interface with no moving images or pop-ups.

2.why: Headings, blue action buttons, progress indicators, and green confirmation messages clearly stand out.

3.why: Persistent navigation, prominent action buttons, and visible next-step prompts make required functions easy to locate.

4.why: The progress tracker, next-step reminders, and visible Logs reduce recall demands, although the user still handles several codes and password rules.

5.why: No visible password-manager option, autofill control, or remember-me setting appears in any screenshot.

6.why: The interface preserves codes and completed actions in Logs, but it does not visibly present saved accounts or other familiar saved items.

7.why: Most text is brief and plainly worded, although phrases such as practice delivery token and account identifiers may be unfamiliar.

8.why: No error state or error message is shown, so the screenshots do not demonstrate whether errors explain both the problem and its correction.

9.why: Instructions describe required inputs and password rules, but no concrete example of a valid password or code entry is shown.

10.why: Password, recovery-code, and security-code actions are distinctly labeled, though no alternative login methods such as face login are offered.

11.why: Each screen focuses on one principal step with only a small number of relevant controls.

12.why: Green status messages, updated progress indicators, and log entries clearly report the outcome of actions.

13.why: Each recovery stage includes a visible next-step banner and an expanded help-and-safe-sign-in-reminders section.

14.why: Inputs and action buttons remain available and password recovery can be restarted, although no actual failed-attempt screen is shown.

15.why: The same layout, colors, typography, navigation, cards, buttons, and help section are used consistently throughout the flow.
